description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) STORM OF FIRE (Devastator Brethren, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges plus the devastator doctrine active for P1's army (doctrine state). SELECT_SHOOTER on the Hellblaster Squad opens unit_selected_to_shoot; a real click spends 1 CP; its ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER] and — with the devastator doctrine — +1 AP; the Hellblasters then shoot the Flash Gitz.
